topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Yeah, well, life’s got a funny way of looping back on itself, doesn’t it? I’m sitting here, flipping through old case files, and the kid’s school slip is staring me down, the name on it a blast from the past. That name. The old man’s got the same tight-lipped grin he flashed me thirty years back, same crisp syllables, letter perfect. I remember thinking he was a slick operator, a runner, never quite sure if he was giving you the straight goods or playing a long con. Now, here I am, with a kid who’s gotta face the same card sharp who taught me to be wary of every angle. I don’t need to teach my kid to dodge and weave, not in a classroom. I’ll be paying a visit to the school. Some things, you handle yourself.
